prompt:
Use only the supplied current.db and README. All windows below are UTC and half-open, selected by logical-operation open time. A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Investigate parcel-index on 2026-05-02, comparing reference 10:00–11:00 with incident 11:00–12:00. For every period and serving physical pool, report operations, terminal failures and their percentage, attempts, failed attempts and their percentage, retried operations, and minimum/maximum applied deadline_ms. Report ordinary window means of every recorded telemetry signal for those pools, and applied changes during 10:00–12:00 (kind, pool, effective time, before/after JSON strings). In assessment, identify the most strongly supported proximal explanation, the affected pool and the terminal-failure increase in percentage points; contrast it with at least one plausible alternative. Distinguish evidence from causal proof. Attribute configuration at the time the operation entered the system, not from today's configuration.
